**(a) Who controls the source?**
The "source" is `chrome.storage.sync` extension data (`SENSITIVE_DATA`). The read is triggered by the *page*: the content script registers a `window.addEventListener("message", …)` listener with **no origin/context check** and handles `{type:"get_storage", key: <attacker-chosen key>}`. Any webpage the content script runs on can choose the storage key and receive the value.

```js
    })
  })(o.key)
```
